amazonAdStorage.description: Set consent for advertising related storage such as cookies(web) or device identifiers(apps).

amazonUserData.description: Set consent to use personal data for online advertising purposes.

audienceDescription.description: The audience description. Must be an alphanumeric, non-null string between 0 to 1000 characters in length.

cpmCents.description: Cost per thousand impressions (CPM) in cents. For example, $1.00 = 100 cents.

currency.description: Currency key as defined in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217. Note that the currency key is required to match the default currency associated with the Amazon DSP account.

audienceName.description: The audience name. Must be an alphanumeric string between 10 to 128 characters in length.

dataSourceCountry.description: A list of country codes describing where data in an audience is collected from. Country code is defined in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2.

errorDescription.description: A human-readable description of the error.

gpp.description: GPP(Global Privacy Platform) consent string that wraps privacy consent information from user.

metadataType.description: The audience metadata type. Only 'DATA_PROVIDER' is currently supported.

recordTtl.description: Time-to-live (ttl), in seconds. The amount of time the record is associated with the audience.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.

tcf.description: TCF(Transparency & Consent Framework) consent string that wraps privacy consent information from user.
